point_of_view.description: The author's stated beliefs, positions and the topics they own, written by the author. The only source of the author's views.

topics.description: The topics the news searches covered; used to label stories.

avoid.description: Topics or kinds of news never to react to.

freshness_hours.description: A story published longer ago than this is stale.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
